content: The get_adsorption_sites_text tool expects a CIF string with proper format, likely starting with "data_". The original file had "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O\n..." The tool gave error "Invalid CIF file with no structures!" maybe because the leading comment line "# generated using pymatgen" confuses parser. We need to provide just the CIF content starting from "data_". Let's try sending the CIF string without the comment line. Use the original read file content but strip the first line.
